page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-224 is an x86_64 server designed to deliver extreme memory capacity alongside high core counts. The machine features 224 dedicated vCPUs paired with 2976 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 13.29 GB of RAM per vCPU. This substantial ratio categorizes the instance as an ultra-high-density memory environment, tailored to satisfy workloads where standard compute-to-memory ratios lead to severe memory starvation.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance does not provision local NVMe or solid-state storage out of the box, mandating network-attached persistent storage for operating system images and persistent state storage. In addition, there are no integrated GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the deployment. Consequently, operational performance is dictated entirely by CPU throughput, system bus memory handling, and external storage networking capabilities.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the m4n-megamem-224 delivers value by consolidating multi-terabyte datasets within a single virtual machine boundary. This approach eliminates the distributed systems overhead, network serialization costs, and latency penalties associated with scaling out across multiple smaller nodes. It is especially suited for enterprise transactional workloads, large-scale SAP HANA deployments, massive in-memory caching clusters, and extensive data processing pipelines that demand monolithic RAM pools.
description: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-224 is an ultra-high-memory server instance built on x86_64 architecture, providing 224 dedicated vCPUs and 2976 GB of system memory. Designed for massive scale, the platform offers an expansive memory footprint of approximately 13.29 GB per core, placing it into an extreme memory-to-compute ratio class. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring workloads to rely completely on network-attached block storage volumes for persistent data. Hardware accelerators such as GPUs are absent, concentrating all system capability on host compute and vast memory capacity. This configuration maximizes consolidation for workloads that cannot be easily partitioned across multiple virtual machines. The m4n-megamem-224 is engineered specifically for large-scale in-memory enterprise databases like SAP HANA, extensive in-memory caching systems, large-scale ETL graph processing, and advanced real-time analytical workloads requiring multi-terabyte working memory.
